entries.headline: 深窓のドッペルト ～輝血香ル黒佐切ノ誣イ言～: Shinsou no Doppelt announced for Nintendo Switch
entries.summary: Idea Factory's Otomate label announced romance adventure Shinsou no Doppelt at Otomate Party 2026. Set in Japan shortly after the war, it centers on false love and is planned for Nintendo Switch.
entries.verification: Reviewed independent reports from AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer. No release date absent from the evidence was added.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: 薄桜鬼 真改 極: Hakuoki Shinkai Kiwami bundles six Hakuoki titles for Nintendo Switch 2
entries.summary: Idea Factory announced Hakuoki Shinkai Kiwami as an Otomate 20th-anniversary title. It combines six Hakuoki games previously released on Nintendo Switch into one Nintendo Switch 2 package.
entries.verification: Reviewed independent reports from 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer; the copy retains only the collection and platform details supported by both.
entries.timeNote: The Denfaminicogamer publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Summer Days remaster launches December 18
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports, citing Overflow, that the Summer Days remaster will launch on December 18, 2026, with preorders opening September 25.
entries.verification: Reviewed the AUTOMATON article. It attributes the announcement to Overflow, but the primary page was not opened in the packet, so this remains a media relay of an official announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Diablo IV reveals a Geralt-themed Barbarian skin tied to a Battle.net expansion purchase
entries.summary: IGN reports that CD Projekt and Blizzard revealed a Geralt-themed Barbarian skin for Diablo IV. It requires preordering or buying The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past on Battle.net, leaving Steam outside that acquisition path.
entries.verification: Reviewed the IGN article. The collaboration's primary page was not opened in the packet, so this remains a media report with the Battle.net and Steam distinction made explicit.
entries.timeNote: The IGN publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Mary-san（メァリーさん）: Mary-san turns recovering a doll's missing body parts into progression
entries.summary: Solo developer Sewo Hayami opened the Steam page for Mary-san. Players control an abandoned French doll and recover missing limbs and eyes to unlock more movement options; the PC release is planned for 2027.
entries.verification: Reviewed the AUTOMATON article. It points to the developer's Steam page, but that primary page was not opened in the packet, so this remains a media relay of an official listing.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Idolmaster SideM console game announced for Switch 2 and Switch
entries.summary: Gematsu reports, citing D3 Publisher, that The Idolmaster SideM is getting an idol-production and scheduling adventure game for Switch 2 and Switch. It covers 49 idols across 16 units of 315 Production; its formal title and release window remain unannounced.
entries.verification: Reviewed the Gematsu article. It attributes the announcement to D3 Publisher, but the corresponding primary page was not opened, so this is not labeled official.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Blizzard Entertainment: Blizzard says its early Diablo V and STARCRAFT reveals were meant to signal confidence in shipping on time
entries.summary: VGC reports Blizzard president Johanna Faries saying the company announced Diablo V and STARCRAFT years before release to convey confidence in delivering major projects on schedule.
entries.verification: Reviewed the VGC article. The statement is attributed to the outlet rather than upgraded to an opened primary interview.
entries.timeNote: The VGC publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Unofficial The Last of Us Part II multiplayer mod canceled as team cites a Sony request
entries.summary: VGC reports that mod team Speclizer canceled its planned PC multiplayer mod for The Last of Us Part II. The team says it received a letter on behalf of Sony Interactive Entertainment asking that the mod not be released; no independent Sony response was confirmed in the packet.
entries.verification: Reviewed the VGC article and its direct quotation of the mod team's statement. Sony's position remains independently unconfirmed, so the item stays under tracking.
entries.timeNote: The VGC publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ベオグラードメトロの子供たち: Beograd Metro no Kodomotachi feature examines how retro visuals frame its psychic drama
entries.summary: An AUTOMATON feature revisits visual novel Beograd Metro no Kodomotachi, examining its combination of PC-98-style pixel art, photographs taken in Serbia by its creator, and electronic music, as well as its themes of self-worth, loneliness, and belonging.
entries.verification: Reviewed the feature first published within the window. The entry presents the article's subject and argument without recasting opinion as official fact.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ぽこ あ ポケモン: Poko a Pokemon player builds a working in-game word processor
entries.summary: AUTOMATON interviewed player Nomutora about a word processor built with Poko a Pokemon's in-game circuits. Unown symbols act as letter keys, while the build supports displayed text, case switching, line breaks, clearing, and Caps Lock.
entries.verification: Reviewed the AUTOMATON article and creator interview. The functions are limited to the demonstrated player build and are not presented as an official system update.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Diablo IV collection announced for Switch 2, Japan release set for September 16
entries.summary: A Nintendo Switch 2 version of the Diablo IV collection was announced at BlizzCon 2026. The opened 4Gamer body text specifies a September 16 release in Japan and Japanese-language support; its headline shows September 15, so this entry does not generalize the dates into one global launch date.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer article supports the platform announcement and Japan date; the one-day headline/body discrepancy is preserved as a limitation.
entries.timeNote: The packet places the report inside the fixed window; no precise time is inferred.

entries.headline: Diablo V is in full production and set roughly 100 years after Diablo IV
entries.summary: Game director Joe Shely told IGN that Diablo V is already in full production and takes place roughly a century after Diablo IV, in a Sanctuary where Diablo has won.
entries.verification: The opened IGN interview directly quotes the Diablo V development team.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.
